arxiv-2111-10227.title: Policy Gradient Approach to Compilation of Variational Quantum Circuits
arxiv-2111-10227.creator: D. A. Herrera-Martí
arxiv-2111-10227.description: Abstract We propose a method for finding approximate compilations of quantum unitary transformations, based on techniques from policy gradient reinforcement learning. The choice of a stochastic policy allows us to rephrase the optimization problem in terms of probability distributions, rather than variational gates.

arxiv-2207-09762.title: Exact results on Quantum search algorithm
arxiv-2207-09762.creator: Saptarshi Roy Chowdhury, Swarupananda Pradhan
arxiv-2207-09762.description: Abstract We obtain exact analytic expressions for the success probability and the dynamics of the off-diagonal terms in the density matrix after arbitrary number of iterations of the generalized Grover operator with two generic phase angles ( α , β ) (\alpha,\beta) . Using this we find for the phase matching condition α = − β = 0.

arxiv-2209-13741.title: A method to explore flavor symmetries of the 3HDM and their implications on lepton masses and mixing
arxiv-2209-13741.creator: Bartosz Dziewit*, Marek Zrałek, Joris Vergeest *, Piotr Chaber
arxiv-2209-13741.description: Abstract We present a method to identify symmetry groups of the Yukawa sector of the three-Higgs-doublet model and to determine the implication that the symmetry has on the lepton masses and mixing. The method can accommodate different hypotheses about the group representation assignments, and thus support the exploration of candidate symmetry groups.

arxiv-2210-07166.title: LAPTh and Université Savoie Mont-Blanc
arxiv-2210-07166.creator: 9 chemin de Bellevue, BP110, Annecy-le-Vieux
arxiv-2210-07166.description: Abstract What charged cosmic rays tell us on dark matter Pierre Salati \,\star LAPTH-Conf-065/22 Plenary talk given at the 14th International Conference on Identification of Dark Matter Vienna, Austria, 18-22 July 2022 Abstract Dark matter particles could be the major component of the haloes of galaxies.

arxiv-2311-10258.title: Uniform regularity for degenerate elliptic equations in perforated domains
arxiv-2311-10258.creator: Zhongwei Shen, Jinping Zhuge
arxiv-2311-10258.description: Abstract . This paper is concerned with a class of degenerate elliptic equations with rapidly oscillating coefficients in periodically perforated domains, which arises in the study of spectrum problems for uniformly elliptic equations in perforated domains. We establish a quantitative convergence rate and obtain the uniform weighted Lipschitz and W 1 , p W^{1,p} estimates.

arxiv-2312-15399.title: Improved security bounds against the Trojan-Horse attack in decoy-state quantum key distribution
arxiv-2312-15399.creator: Zijian Li 1 , Bingbing Zheng 1 , Chengxian Zhang 1 , Zhenrong Zhang 2 , Hong-Bo Xie 3 , Kejin Wei, 1,∗
arxiv-2312-15399.description: Abstract In a quantum Trojan-horse attack (THA), eavesdroppers learn encoded information by injecting bright light into encoded or decoded devices of quantum key distribution (QKD) systems. These attacks severely compromise the security of non-isolated systems. Thus, analytical security bound was derived in previous studies. However, these studies achieved poor performance unless the devices were strongly isolated.

arxiv-2401-13718.title: Rainbow gravity effects on relativistic quantum oscillator field in a topological defect cosmological space-time
arxiv-2401-13718.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by . In this paper, we investigate the quantum dynamics of scalar and oscillator fields in a topological defect space-time background under the influence of rainbow gravity’s. The rainbow gravity’s are introduced into the considered cosmological space-time geometry by replacing the temporal part d ​ t → d ​ t ℱ ⁡ ( χ ) dt\to\frac{dt}{\mathcal{F}(\chi)} and the spatial part d ​ x i → d ​ x i ℋ ⁡ ( χ ) dx^{i}\to\frac{dx^{i}}{\mathcal{H}(\chi)} , where ℱ , ℋ \mathcal{F},\mathcal{H} are the rainbow functions

arxiv-2403-16399.title: Transient Waiting Time Distributions in Small Call Centres with Skills-Based Routing
arxiv-2403-16399.creator: Mark Fackrell, Hritika Gupta, Peter G. Taylor
arxiv-2403-16399.description: Abstract Many call centres are subject to service level agreements that stipulate that they must achieve targets in terms of the proportion of calls that are answered within a specified time. In order to manage a centre so that targets like these are met, we need to have a method of calculating the waiting time distributions experienced by customers.

arxiv-2405-01641.title: Spectral form factor in chaotic, localized, and integrable open quantum many-body systems
arxiv-2405-01641.creator: Jiachen Li ∗, Stephen Yan ∗, Tomaž Prosen, Amos Chan
arxiv-2405-01641.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jiachen Li ∗, Stephen Yan ∗, Tomaž Prosen, Amos Chan. We numerically study the spectral statistics of open quantum many-body systems (OQMBS) as signatures of quantum chaos (or the lack thereof), using the dissipative spectral form factor (DSFF), a generalization of the spectral form factor to complex spectra.

arxiv-2411-03730.title: NeurIPS 2023 Competition: Privacy Preserving Federated Learning Document VQA
arxiv-2411-03730.creator: Marlon Tobaben, Mohamed Ali Souibgui, Rubèn Tito, Khanh Nguyen, Raouf Kerkouche, Kangsoo Jung, Joonas Jälkö, Lei Kang, Andrey Barsky, Vincent Poulain d’Andecy, Aurélie JOSEPH Competition Organizers, Aashiq Muhamed, Kevin Kuo , Virginia Smith, Yusuke Yamasaki, Takumi Fukami, Kenta Niwa, Iifan Tyou, H
arxiv-2411-03730.description: Abstract The Privacy Preserving Federated Learning Document VQA (PFL-DocVQA) competition challenged the community to develop provably private and communication-efficient solutions in a federated setting for a real-life use case: invoice processing. The competition introduced a dataset of real invoice documents, along with associated questions and answers requiring information extraction and reasoning over the document images.

arxiv-2504-05472.title: Assessing the Role of Intrinsic Variability in Black Hole Parameter Inference using Multi-Epoch EHT Data
arxiv-2504-05472.creator: Dominic O. Chang, Michael D. Johnson, Paul Tiede
arxiv-2504-05472.description: Abstract Event Horizon Telescope (EHT) observations of M87* provide a means of constraining parameters of both the black hole and its surrounding plasma. However, intrinsic variability of the emitting material introduces a major source of systematic uncertainty, complicating parameter inference.

arxiv-2507-17326.title: Application of Whisper in Clinical Practice: the Post-Stroke Speech Assessment during a Naming Task Thanks:
arxiv-2507-17326.creator: Milena Davudova* Department of Neuroimaging King’s College London London, UK milena.davudova@kcl.ac.uk Ziyuan Cai * Department of Neuroimaging King’s College London London, UK ziyuan.1.cai@kcl.ac.uk Valentina Giunchiglia Department of Brain Sciences Imperial College London London, UK v.giunchiglia20
arxiv-2507-17326.description: Abstract Detailed assessment of language impairment following stroke remains a cognitively complex and clinician-intensive task, limiting timely and scalable diagnosis. Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR) foundation models offer a promising pathway to augment human evaluation through intelligent systems, but their effectiveness in the context of speech and language impairment remains uncertain.

arxiv-2510-12189.title: Agent-Based Simulation of a Financial Market with Large Language Models
arxiv-2510-12189.creator: Ryuji Hashimoto, Takehiro Takayanagi, Masahiro Suzuki, Kiyoshi Izumi
arxiv-2510-12189.description: Abstract In real-world stock markets, certain chart patterns—such as price declines near historical highs—cannot be fully explained by fundamentals alone. These phenomena suggest the presence of path dependence in price formation, where investor decisions are influenced not only by current market conditions but also by the trajectory of prices leading up to the present.

arxiv-2603-12595.creator: Gihoon Kim, Euntai Kim

europmc-pmc9252913.title: The 5th edition of the World Health Organization Classification of Haematolymphoid Tumours: Myeloid and Histiocytic/Dendritic Neoplasms.
europmc-pmc9252913.creator: Khoury JD, Solary E, Abla O, Akkari Y, Alaggio R, Apperley JF, Bejar R, Berti E, Busque L, Chan JKC, Chen W, Chen X, Chng WJ, Choi JK, Colmenero I, Coupland SE, Cross NCP, De Jong D, Elghetany MT, Takahashi E, Emile JF, Ferry J, Fogelstrand L, Fontenay M, Germing U, Gujral S, Haferlach T, Harrison C, Hodge JC, Hu S, Jansen JH, Kanagal-Shamanna R, Kantarjian HM, Kratz CP, Li XQ, Lim MS, Loeb K, Loghavi S, Marcogliese A, Meshinchi S, Michaels P, Naresh KN, Natkunam Y, Nejati R, Ott G, Padron E, Patel KP, Patkar N, Picarsic J, Platzbecker U, Roberts I, Schuh A, Sewell W, Siebert R, Tembhare P, Tyner J, Verstovsek S, Wang W, Wood B, Xiao W, Yeung C, Hochhaus A.

This paper summarizes the new WHO...

pmc-10529649.title: Diagnostic Tools for Cutaneous Leishmaniasis Caused by Leishmania donovani: A Narrative Review
pmc-10529649.creator: Sachee Bhanu Piyasiri, Rajika Dewasurendra, Nilakshi Samaranayake, Nadira Karunaweera, Alessandro Russo
pmc-10529649.description: Leishmaniasis, a neglected tropical disease, encompasses a spectrum of clinical conditions and poses a significant risk of infection to over one billion people worldwide. Visceral leishmaniasis (VL) in the Indian sub-continent (ISC), where the causative parasite is Leishmania donovani, is targeted for elimination by 2025, with some countries already reaching such targets.

pmc-10593235.title: ALGD-ORB: An improved image feature extraction algorithm with adaptive threshold and local gray difference
pmc-10593235.creator: Guoming Chu, Yan Peng, Xuhong Luo, Muhammad Shahid Farid, Muhammad Shahid Farid, Muhammad Shahid Farid
pmc-10593235.description: Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) technology is crucial for achieving spatial localization and autonomous navigation. Finding image features that are representative presents a key challenge in visual SLAM systems. The widely used ORB (Oriented FAST and Rotating BRIEF) algorithm achieves rapid image feature extraction.

pmc-10667079.title: Macroamylasemia as a Rare Cause of Hyperamylasemia: A Case Report
pmc-10667079.creator: Wejdan M Al-Johani
pmc-10667079.description: Macroamylasemia is a rare condition characterized by the formation of an amylase–globulin complex that is too large to be readily excreted by the kidneys and leads to elevated serum amylase levels. It is a benign condition lacking severe signs and symptoms that does not require treatment.

pmc-11362328.title: Estimating nonlinear effects of random slopes: A comparison of multilevel structural equation modeling with a two-step, a single-indicator, and a plausible values approach
pmc-11362328.creator: Sarah Humberg, Simon Grund, Steffen Nestler
pmc-11362328.description: Multilevel structural equation modeling (MSEM) is a statistical framework of major relevance for research concerned with people’s intrapersonal dynamics. An application domain that is rapidly gaining relevance is the study of individual differences in the within-person association (WPA) of variables that fluctuate over time.

pmc-11458175.title: Robust, fast and accurate mapping of diffusional mean kurtosis
pmc-11458175.creator: Megan E Farquhar, Qianqian Yang, Viktor Vegh, Jennifer Flegg, Megan E Farquhar, Qianqian Yang, Viktor Vegh
pmc-11458175.description: Diffusional kurtosis imaging (DKI) is a methodology for measuring the extent of non-Gaussian diffusion in biological tissue, which has shown great promise in clinical diagnosis, treatment planning, and monitoring of many neurological diseases and disorders. However, robust, fast, and accurate estimation of kurtosis from clinically feasible data acquisitions remains a challenge.

pmc-11473688.title: Live birth and maternity outcome in childhood and adolescent cancer survivors under 18 years at diagnosis: a 40-year population-based cohort study
pmc-11473688.creator: W. H. Wallace, T. W. Kelsey, D. Morrison, R. A. Anderson
pmc-11473688.description: BackgroundSurvival from childhood and adolescent cancer has increased, but the chance of a livebirth in female survivors under 18 years at diagnosis may be reduced.MethodsWe performed a national population-based analysis, including all female cancer survivors diagnosed in Scotland before the age of 18 years between 1981 and 2012. Scottish Cancer Registry records were linked to Scottish maternity records.

pmc-12512911.title: The predictive value of serum lipoprotein(a) level for new-onset aortic valve calcification in patients with coronary artery disease
pmc-12512911.creator: Yao Ren, Yuying Deng
pmc-12512911.description: BackgroundPatients suffering coronary artery disease (CAD) with calcific aortic valve disease (CAVD) are facing worse prognosis with more complex operation strategies. As the primary stage of CAVD, it is helpful to confirm the risk factors of aortic valve calcification (AVC) in advance for exploring the secondary prevention as well as early intervention strategies of CAVD for CAD patients.

pmc-12552883.title: Solitons in ultrafast semiconductor lasers with saturable absorber
pmc-12552883.creator: Luigi Lugiato, Franco Prati, Massimo Brambilla, Lorenzo Luigi Columbo
pmc-12552883.description: We describe structure localization and dissipative solitons in a semiconductor laser with a saturable absorber exhibiting gain/absorption recovery times shorter than the photon lifetime. Under assumptions compatible with QCL characteristics and graphene-based absorbers, we study the existence and stability of solitons, along with their dynamical behavior. Numerical simulations confirm the robustness of our predictions.

pmc-13048976.title: What is the Addictive Potential from Vaping?
pmc-13048976.creator: Karl Erik Lund, Tord Finne Vedøy
pmc-13048976.description: AimThe present study discusses the addictive potential from vaping heuristically in view of existing research literature. We also paying attention to aayouth perspective in a Norwegian context.MethodsThe study compiled paradigmatic explanations of addiction and then conducted a narrative review of the sparse literature on vape addiction. We draw som conclusions based on the results from a number of review-based viewpoints.

pmc-13336091.title: Temperature‐Driven Emission Redistribution of Yb2+ in SrB4O7 Enables Highly Sensitive Optical Thermometry Supported by Multiple Linear Regression
pmc-13336091.creator: Fang Zhao, Teng Zheng, Przemysław Woźny, Miguel A. Hernández‐Rodríguez, Shiqing Xu, Inocencio R. Martín, Marcin Runowski
pmc-13336091.description: Optical thermometry is a modern, non‐contact technique for temperature measurements, and its performance is fundamentally determined by the thermometric parameters employed. The use of unique luminescence from some divalent lanthanide ions may significantly boost the thermometric performance of optical sensors. Here, a first luminescent thermometer based on the rarely observed UV emission of Yb2+ is presented.

pmc-13426107.title: Sleep Quality Assessment in Trauma Patients Requiring Intensive Care: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-13426107.creator: Sathiya G Priya, Yudhyavir Singh, Kapil Dev Soni, Richa Aggarwal, Chhavi Sawhney, Babita Gupta
pmc-13426107.description: BackgroundSleep is vital for healing, cognitive function, immunity regulation, hormonal balance, and waste clearance. Sleep deprivation is common among intensive care unit (ICU) patients, particularly those receiving mechanical ventilation. Fragmented sleep, pain, noise, and other factors adversely affect recovery and outcomes. Trauma patients often experience increased pain from their injuries.

pmc-13439172.title: Integrated proteomic and metabolomic analyses implicate redox-metabolic pathways in PTSD-associated multisystem disease and accelerated aging
pmc-13439172.creator: Pei-Fen Kuan, Frank D Mann, Xiaohua Yang, Roman Kotov, Sean Clouston, Olga Ilkayeva, Michael Muehlbauer, Christopher B Newgard, Benjamin J Luft

pmc-13553122.title: Artificial intelligence in healthcare in Latin America and Colombia: bridging gaps and leveraging opportunities
pmc-13553122.creator: Santiago Sierra-Castillo, David Aristizábal-Colorado, Martha Eugenia Reyes-Sarmiento
pmc-13553122.description: made, healthcare services are organized, and health systems are structured1. From diagnostic algorithms and predictive models to the recent emergence of generative models and generative AI tools, AI has evolved from isolated applications into technologies capable of reshaping clinical care processes as well as operational and administrative functions related to healthcare delivery2-5.

pmc-13556473.title: 173. Cytochrome variability and the escalation of clinical complexity in neurodevelopmental disorders
pmc-13556473.creator: M Geiser, J Convertini, V Guinchat
pmc-13556473.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundChallenging behaviors (CB), including aggression, self-injury, and severe agitation, are a major cause of suffering and institutionalization in individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders (NDD). Their multifactorial nature often leads to empirical psychopharmacological escalation and polypharmacy.

pmc-13591281.title: Differential analysis of microbial interaction networks
pmc-13591281.creator: Marianna Milano, Pietro Hiram Guzzi
pmc-13591281.description: Microbiome studies increasingly indicate that disease-associated shifts cannot be understood from compositional changes alone. The functional architecture of microbial communities—encoded in patterns of association among microbial gene families—may reveal how these systems reorganize across biological conditions. Here, we present a network-based framework for characterizing microbiome rewiring across conditions.

uslaw-usc-t7-s6924.title: 7 U.S.C. § 6924 — Food Loss and Waste Reduction Liaison
uslaw-usc-t7-s6924.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s6924.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 98 (Department Of Agriculture Reorganization); Subchapter I (General Reorganization Authorities). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Establishment The Secretary shall establish a Food Loss and Waste Reduction Liaison to coordinate Federal, State, local, and nongovernmental programs, and other efforts, to measure and reduce the incidence of food loss and waste in accordance with this section.
